name: error-reporting
body: Validation is fail-fast: exactly one error is reported (the first found). It states file, line if known, full path, what is wrong and how to fix it, e.g. `slides/3-team.md:12 › column[1] › people[0] › name: required — add a name: value`. Same text in terminal and browser error page. The same path form extends to nested section instances (e.g. `columns[2] › blocks[1]`, nested-section-validation), so the notation is uniform at any containment depth.
